pages.title: Unified Notes II
pages.text: The middle unified volume: countable infinity, catalysts of eternity, the Christoffel symbols of curved space, pocket universes, white holes, gravitons. Every page cross-references three others. It is a delight to read and almost impossible to summarise.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I bound an aleph-null shard to a Christoffel symbol and a pocket universe to a white hole fragment, with an eternity catalyst and a graviton crystal to hold the threads. The Femtoscale line found the common thread I had been sensing for months.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Unified Dossier.
